blocked.title: 下载制品包
blocked.reason: Download returns a file stream but documents neither a response media type nor error-envelope handling; request Content-Type text/plain does not establish the response transport. No unguarded HTTP-200 binary success is inferred.

request_notes: Normalize the documented Double threshold to the supported floating-point input type without changing the wire number.
Application and image-mode conditions are enforced where the catalog can express them; compound Kubernetes/package/private-image conditions remain documented and server validated.
Correct the IAMGE spelling in version-edit help to IMAGE, matching the explicit application type enum; preserve raw evidence.

The regionCode parameter on version create/edit is conditional on KUBERNETES in its description, despite the unconditional required marker. Preserve the condition rather than requiring an image region for ECS packages.
Release list and batch-release taskList are nested arrays in the captured body examples despite Array of Objects table labels; preserve batch grouping with structured JSON input, without flattening.

notes: Application and deployment queries expose statusCd/state but do not publish complete terminal-state enums. A captured RUNNING or SUCCEEDED example alone is not a reviewed lifecycle contract.
Import log finish indicates that a pipeline ended, not that it succeeded; no completion waiter is inferred.
Exact application-instance scaling policy supports enabled/disabled configuration waiters using its documented Boolean enable field.
